source: Google Flow, Nano Banana 2, user-authorized in-app browser
direction: Premium miniature Vietnamese horse-race board game in a magical garden. Rounded wooden toy horses in red, blue, green and yellow, tiny castles, soft warm light, tactile wood and painted surfaces. No UI, typography, watermark or photorealistic children.

assets.use: Art direction reference; not loaded by gameplay

notes: Source images were visually inspected, retrieved with the browser pageAssets capability and resized/compressed to WebP. Illustrative board markings are not a rules reference. The interactive board and horses are original procedural Three.js geometry, independent of the cover image. Audio reuses the existing Dragon Forest track plus locally synthesized effects. No signed image URLs or account credentials are stored.
